---
title: "Computing spatial covariates"
format: html
---


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
commune <- "Amparafaravola"
ndvi <- read_csv("data/Geo_query/NDVI_communes.csv")
df <- ndvi
plot_ndvi <- function(df = ndvi, commune) {
  df_filtered <- df %>%
    filter(shapeName == commune) %>%
    select(shapeName, starts_with("ltdr")) %>%
    pivot_longer(-shapeName) %>%
    mutate(year = as.numeric(str_extract(name, "[0-9]{4}"))) %>%
    arrange(year)

  df_filtered %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = year, y = value, group = shapeName)) +
    geom_line(color = "grey40") +
    geom_point(size = 2, color = "darkgreen") +
    #  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(1980, max(df_filtered$year, na.rm = TRUE)),
      breaks = seq(1980, max(df_filtered$year, na.rm = TRUE), by = 5)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Année",
      y = "NDVI annuel moyen",
      title = paste(
        "Évolution du NDVI pour la commune de",
        unique(df_filtered$shapeName)
      )
    )
}
plot_ndvi(commune = "Amparafaravola")
plot_ndvi(commune = "Ilafy")
plot_ndvi(commune = "Feramanga Nord")
plot_ndvi(commune = "Morarano Chrome")

```
